powers.name: Sandpit
powers.description: When The Insatiable takes its turn, you will be eaten and die.

powers.name: Vulnerable
powers.description: Receive 50% more damage from Attacks for 2 turns.

ordered_sequence.rules: Get farther away. Increase Sandpit by 1. Increase the cost of this card by 1.
Deal 6 damage. Deals 2 additional damage for each Vulnerable on the enemy.
Deal 32 damage. Deals 2 additional damage for ALL your cards containing “Strike”.

label.then: End turn, unless a new observation requires a revision.
